name: Write a plant review — decision fork demo
summary: A customer reviews a delivered plant. After viewing their order, the system chains two decision branches before reaching the review form: first it checks whether the item has already been reviewed, then whether it has been delivered. Only when both checks pass does the customer land on the write-review screen. FIXTURE — demo of ADR-025 decision-diamond rendering in the Leafcutter Atlas flows view.

steps.label: View Order
steps.human: The customer opens their order detail page to see the plant they received.

steps.label: Write Review
steps.human: The customer composes a star rating and written review for the plant.

steps.label: Submit Review
steps.human: The review is submitted and appears on the plant detail page.

branches.condition: Customer has already reviewed this order item
branches.label: Already Reviewed
branches.human: The customer has already left a review for this plant from this order; the system shows the existing review instead.

branches.label: Not Delivered
branches.human: The order has not been marked delivered yet; the system blocks the review form and prompts the customer to wait.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a customer who has received a plant order
acceptance_scenarios.when: the customer opens their order detail page
acceptance_scenarios.then: they see the plant name, delivery status, and a Leave a review prompt

acceptance_scenarios.given: the customer taps Leave a review and passes both decision checks
acceptance_scenarios.then: they can enter a star rating and free-text review
the review appears on the plant detail page and the order detail shows Reviewed

acceptance_scenarios.given: the customer tries to review a plant they already reviewed from this order
acceptance_scenarios.when: they navigate to the review form
acceptance_scenarios.then: the system redirects them to their existing review

acceptance_scenarios.given: the customer tries to review an undelivered order item
acceptance_scenarios.then: the system shows a message: you can review this plant after it is delivered
